issues.description: Field 'birthday' in class de.tum.in.ase.eist.model.Person has inconsistent types across artifacts. In the template repository Person.java the 'birthday' field is declared as java.time.LocalDate (private LocalDate birthday;). In the solution repository Person.java the field is declared as String (private String birthday;), while its getter and setter in the same solution class use java.time.LocalDate, and the tests create and set LocalDate values. This mismatch (field type != accessor signatures and != tests) will cause compilation errors and prevents running the provided tests and examples.
issues.suggestedFix: In solution/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java change the declaration of the 'birthday' field from String to java.time.LocalDate (e.g., 'private LocalDate birthday;') and ensure the file imports java.time.LocalDate. This will align the field type with the existing getter/setter signatures and the tests, restoring compilation and consistent behavior.
